title: 第二十八章  请君入梦
content_zh:
他们被带到风月楼五层，另外的一间房后，赖元就退了出去。玉京子已经在此等候，在他面前的白玉桌上，摆满了各种精致的菜肴。

    比起刚才房间，这里摆设要华丽得多，也许是因为本体是蛇的原因，家具都是玉石玛瑙之类的石材打造。

    “来，大家肯定都饿了，咱们先吃再聊。”玉京子热情地招呼道。

    众人上桌后，尽管玉京子热情非常，却没人动筷子，气氛一度有些尴尬。

    “哈哈。”玉京子笑道：“诸位放心，孤本体虽然是蝮虫，但早已跨入天人境，饮食等生活习性早与常人无异。”

    “你们看这是来自苕水的鮆鱼，这个鱼有个很明显的特征，就是如刀长薄尖刀形，所以又叫刀鱼。”玉京子怕众人不信，将菜都介绍了一遍。

    “这也叫鹄，这可是来自钟山。”

    “现在这里被灰雾封锁，只能委屈贵客吃这种牛肉。这肉的味道虽然很是一般。可这种牛，你每天割它块肉，第二天就会长出来，能每天吃到新鲜的肉。”

    看着面前这些，色香俱佳的美味佳肴，墨攻行吞了吞口水，把心一横，抓起一块肉。

    “就算是老鼠，也值了。”

    玉京子又拿出一壶酒，瓶盖一打开，一股熟悉的香味就飘出。

    “各位，来点。”玉京子劝道。

    “不了，不了，你别客气，我们自己来。”墨攻行说道。

    “这可是桃花醉。”玉京子劝道。

    一听到桃花醉得酒名，墨非夜就想起来，自己觉得这个香味这么熟悉，是因为当初在竹筏上，尘洗月就一直喝的这个酒。

    “你们知道断江退潮大红袍吧。”玉京子神秘兮兮地说道：“和你们说，这个桃花醉，就是这一代的大红袍尘洗月所酿，我因为和他有些交情，才弄了几坛。”

    说完就喝了一口，叹息地说道：“可惜了，号称十里桃花十里醉的桃花醉，以后喝不到了。”

    听到玉京子这句话，两人还以为尘洗月出了什么事，他俩和尘洗月也算有些渊源。

    “那婆娘搬到桃花林后，尘洗月就不能酿酒，只怕以后不会有桃花醉。”

    那名身背巨剑，一张萝莉脸的姑姑形象，出现在两人的脑海中。

    才几杯酒下肚，玉京子脸就涨得通红。

    “诸位说实话，我有一事相求。”也不管诸人同没同意，玉京子眯着眼，满脸醉意地说道。

    “君上，我们刚才去灰雾，也没任何发现。”墨非夜以为玉京子，是说灰雾之事。

    玉京子有些醉意地摆摆手：“不是这个，我起初以为，你们几人进来，是灰雾出现变化。刚派人查看，发现一切如旧，我想肯定是蜃珠，吞吐月光的时候，你们正好在风月楼的位置，意外进来。”

    “我是有其余的事求你们。”玉京子拿起一杯酒，一饮而尽。

    “大概几百年前，你们也知道，我活得太久了，时间已经对我失去了意义。那时候我还在周游天下，看遍天下的美景。”

    “那一日我路过唐国，看到不远处的一处山脉，看其郁郁青青，山川相缭，于是临时起意，决定登高望远，到顶峰时果然没让我失望，上面怪石林立，芳草罗生，景色优美至极。”

    玉京子眯着眼睛，沉浸在回忆之中：“我登高望远，看到一团云气漂浮在不远处，它随风而动，不停地变换形状，如松，如马，如车，最后竟化成一名美人，手扬长袖，似在期盼自己的情郎。”
content_en:
After they were taken to another room on the fifth floor of Fengyue Building, Lai Yuan withdrew. Yu Jingzi is already waiting here. The white jade table in front of him is filled with various exquisite dishes.

    Compared to the room just now, the furnishings here are much more gorgeous, perhaps because the body is a snake, and the furniture is made of jade, agate and other stones.

    "Come on, everyone must be hungry. Let's eat first and then talk." Yu Jingzi greeted warmly.

    After everyone arrived at the table, even though Yu Jingzi was very enthusiastic, no one moved their chopsticks, and the atmosphere was a bit awkward for a while.

    "Haha." Yu Jingzi said with a smile: "Don't worry, everyone, although the original body is a viper, it has already entered the realm of heaven and humans, and its living habits such as eating and drinking are no different from ordinary people."

    "You see, this is the saury fish from Tiao Shui. This fish has a very obvious characteristic, which is that it is shaped like a knife with a long and thin tip, so it is also called saury fish." Yu Jingzi was afraid that everyone would not believe it, so he introduced all the dishes.

    "This is also called Hu, and it comes from Zhongshan."

    "Now that this place is blocked by gray fog, we can only force our distinguished guests to eat this kind of beef. Although the taste of this meat is very ordinary. But if you cut a piece of this kind of beef every day, it will grow back the next day, and you can eat fresh meat every day."

    Looking at the delicious food in front of him, Mo Gongxing swallowed his saliva, shuddered, and grabbed a piece of meat.

    "Even if it's a mouse, it's worth it."

    Yu Jingzi took out another bottle of wine. As soon as the bottle cap was opened, a familiar fragrance wafted out.

    "Everyone, have some." Yu Jingzi advised.

    "No, no, you're welcome, we'll do it ourselves." Mo Jengxing said.

    "This is peach blossom drunkenness." Yu Jingzi advised.

    As soon as he heard the name of Peach Blossom Drunken Wine, Mo Feiye remembered that the reason why he found this fragrance so familiar was because Chen Xiyue had been drinking this wine on the bamboo raft.

    "You know Duanjiang Etide Dahongpao, right?" Yu Jingzi said mysteriously: "Let me tell you, this peach blossom drunkenness is brewed by Dahongpao Chen Xinyue of this generation. Because I have some friendship with him, I made a few jars."

    After finishing speaking, he took a sip and said with a sigh: "It's a pity that Peach Blossom Zui, which is known as Ten Miles of Peach Blossom and Ten Miles of Drunk, will no longer be available for drinking."

    Hearing Yu Jingzi's words, the two of them thought something had happened to Chen Xiyue, and they had some connection with Chen Xiyue.

    "After that woman moved to the Peach Blossom Forest, Chen Xiyue won't be able to make wine. I'm afraid there will be no Peach Blossom Drunk in the future."

    The image of the aunt with a giant sword on her back and a loli face appeared in their minds.

    After just a few glasses of wine, Yu Jingzi's face turned red.

    "Everyone, tell the truth, I have something to ask for." Regardless of whether everyone agrees or not, Yu Jingzi said drunkenly with his eyes narrowed.

    "Your Majesty, we just went to Gray Fog and found nothing." Mo Feiye thought Yu Jingzi was talking about Gray Fog.

    Yu Jingzi waved her hands drunkenly: "That's not it. At first, I thought that when you guys came in, there was a change in the gray fog. I just sent someone to check and found that everything was the same as before. I thought it must be a mirage. When I was swallowing the moonlight, you happened to be in the Fengyue Tower and came in unexpectedly."

    "I have something else to ask you for." Yu Jingzi picked up a glass of wine and drank it down in one gulp.

    "About a few hundred years ago, as you all know, I have lived too long and time has lost its meaning to me. At that time, I was still traveling around the world and seeing all the beautiful places in the world."

    "That day I was passing by the Kingdom of Tang and saw a mountain range not far away. I saw the green mountains and rivers, so I made an impromptu decision to climb up and look far. When I reached the top, I was not disappointed. There were many strange rocks and grass growing on it, and the scenery was extremely beautiful."

    Yu Jingzi squinted her eyes and was immersed in memories: "I climbed up and looked into the distance, and saw a cloud floating not far away. It moved with the wind, constantly changing its shape, like a pine, like a horse, like a car, and finally turned into a beauty, holding up her long sleeves, as if she was looking forward to her lover."
